### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 4f939b9343359250407aaa5404964e82a6a0fe1f
* **PR origin:** #51

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Deferred Review Nitpick

#### Expected Behavior

The `review_comments` jq union in `_phase_check_pr_comments_since_push` should emit each review comment exactly once with `{createdAt, body, author}`.

#### Actual Behavior

`plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh:159-160` produces a 2-arm union:

```
review_comments: [.reviews[]?.body? | select(. != null and . != "") ] | map({body: .}) +
                 [.reviews[]? | select(.body != null and .body != "") | {createdAt: .submittedAt, body: .body, author: .author.login}]
```

The first arm produces `{body: "..."}` objects with no `createdAt`/`author`. The downstream Python filter (`if ca and ca > ts`) silently ignores them, but the dead arm is misleading and uncovered by tests (the new test stubs return pre-shaped JSON, bypassing the jq transform). Recommend deleting the first arm.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh
data.title: [merge-to-main-pr]: review_comments jq union has dead arm -> body-only objects emitted with no createdAt
